TRITON.definition: Tropical marine gastropods having beautifully colored spiral shells.

INTRO.gloss: formally making a person known to another or to the public
INTRO.definition: Formally making a person known to another or to the public.

IRON.gloss: a heavy ductile magnetic metallic element
IRON.definition: A heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood.

RIOT.gloss: a public act of violence by an unruly mob
RIOT.definition: A public act of violence by an unruly mob.

TORN.gloss: having edges that are jagged from injury
TORN.definition: Having edges that are jagged from injury.

TRIO.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one
TRIO.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one.

TINT.gloss: a quality of a given color that differs slightly from another color
TINT.definition: A quality of a given color that differs slightly from another color.
TINT.example: After several trials he mixed the shade of pink that she wanted.

NOT.gloss: negation of a word or group of words
NOT.definition: Negation of a word or group of words.

TON.gloss: a United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds
TON.definition: A United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds.

ION.gloss: a particle that is electrically charged
ION.definition: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons.

TIN.gloss: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion
TIN.definition: A silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide.

ROT.gloss: a state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor
ROT.definition: A state of decay usually accompanied by an offensive odor.

TROT.gloss: run at a moderately swift pace
TROT.definition: Run at a moderately swift pace.

TORT.gloss: any wrongdoing for which an action for damages may be brought
TORT.definition: (law) any wrongdoing for which an action for damages may be brought.
